cases.page.title: Cases
cases.page.subtitle: Real production challenges in engineering, architecture, and products solved with tangible impact.
cases.pagarme.title: Payment Gateway & Split Migration (Pagar.me v5)
cases.pagarme.summary: Production migration to Pagar.me v5 using Factory Pattern, automated multi-receiver split and zero downtime.
cases.pagarme.problem: Needed to migrate from legacy gateway to Pagar.me v5 (revamped API, values in cents, complex split) without disrupting live production sales.
cases.pagarme.approach: Implemented a decoupled Factory Pattern architecture to switch gateways via environment variables, with resilient automated split logic for PIX, Cards and Boleto.
cases.pagarme.result: Operating 100% in production with zero downtime. Automated payment splitting across vendors and carriers without friction.
cases.saas.title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture & Granular RBAC
cases.saas.summary: B2B automotive platform connecting dealerships and stores with strict multi-tenant data isolation.
cases.saas.problem: Connect competing dealerships and retailers in a unified system while guaranteeing absolute tenant data isolation and strict role hierarchy.
cases.saas.approach: Architected multi-tenant scope isolation middleware and granular RBAC using Next.js on frontend and Node.js + Prisma on backend.
cases.saas.result: Multiple enterprise clients operating simultaneously in production with complete security and data segregation.
cases.saas.metric1.label: Active Clients
cases.saas.metric2.label: Security
cases.saas.metric3.label: Architecture
cases.chat.title: Real-Time Chat & Media Upload via Firebase
cases.chat.summary: Secure, high-performance photo and file sharing inside an e-commerce real-time chat.
cases.chat.problem: Image upload in e-commerce chat was crashing client apps and incurring high costs when uploading raw binaries directly to real-time nodes.
cases.chat.approach: Engineered a hybrid pipeline: authenticated custom API endpoint handles file upload and compression, dispatching only lightweight CDN URLs to Firebase real-time nodes.
cases.chat.result: Ultra-fast, stable chat without lags. Established as the company benchmark architecture for messaging across products.
cases.dashboard.title: Scalable Design System & Analytics Dashboards
cases.dashboard.summary: Modular component library that accelerated 5+ enterprise dashboard deliveries by 3x.
cases.dashboard.problem: Multiple internal and client tools required complex dashboards under tight deadlines, facing rework and visual inconsistencies.
cases.dashboard.approach: Built a unified Design System in React, TypeScript and Styled-Components with dynamic tables, advanced filtering, and charts via Chart.js and Recharts.
cases.dashboard.result: Delivered 5+ complex dashboards in production with dramatic drop in development time and pixel-perfect design parity.

cases.push.title: Push Notification Pipeline (Expo + Firebase FCM v1)
cases.push.summary: Real-time dispatch pipeline between Node.js backend, React Native apps, and drivers/customers.
cases.push.problem: Drivers and customers lacked instant order alerts, causing dispatch delays and lost deliveries in logistics operations.
cases.push.approach: Engineered end-to-end pipeline: Google Cloud IAM + FCM v1 in Strapi/Node.js backend dispatching via Expo Push API, paired with reactive React Query cache invalidation listeners.
cases.push.result: 100% of drivers alerted in under 2 seconds. Real-time screen route updates without manual app refresh.

skills.favorites.label: My favorites
skills.favorites.react.desc: It's the technology I use most and feel most comfortable with. The way React organizes UI into reusable components makes everything click, especially in large projects. The ecosystem is massive and the community solves virtually any problem.
skills.favorites.next.desc: Working with Next.js changed how I think about web apps. SSR, SSG, API routes, image optimization — all built in. It's my default framework when starting any professional project, especially when SEO and performance matter.
skills.favorites.ts.desc: Once I started using TypeScript, I can't imagine working without it. Errors show up before running the code, the IDE actually helps you and the codebase becomes much easier to maintain. In teams, the difference is even greater.
cases.qrcode.title: Camera Scanner & QR Code Parser
cases.qrcode.summary: High-speed mobile camera scanning for physical shipping labels and PDF processing.
cases.qrcode.problem: Delivery drivers couldn't scan package labels on mobile due to corrupted payloads in backend-generated PDF files.
cases.qrcode.approach: Fixed backend payload serialization and engineered a resilient parser (JSON + raw string fallback) paired with Expo Camera and haptic feedback.
cases.qrcode.result: Zero scan errors in production field testing. Sorting and package intake operations fully stabilized.
cases.bizrule.title: Delivery Workflow Enforcement & Business Logic UI
cases.bizrule.summary: Physical step validation and conditional action locking in the mobile UI.
cases.bizrule.problem: Drivers were able to complete deliveries without physically scanning the package barcode first, causing inventory loss.
cases.bizrule.approach: Exposed package custody status in the API and dynamically enforced UI state: disabled finish button and routed card clicks to scanner camera.
cases.bizrule.result: 100% operational compliance. Bypassing barcode intake before drop-off is now systematically prevented.
cases.realtimestate.title: Reactive State Sync (React Query)
cases.realtimestate.summary: Instant optimistic UI updates and screen synchronization with zero reload.
cases.realtimestate.problem: After successful scanning, mobile screens showed outdated states until the driver manually force-restarted the app.
cases.realtimestate.approach: Orchestrated optimistic mutations and targeted cache invalidations in React Query with immediate success modals.
cases.realtimestate.result: Instant UI response. Drivers scan and the button updates to 'Deliver Order' in the exact same fraction of a second.
